CSI · REAL DATA · HEDGE

Is one index-level model enough to hedge a real CSI?

On real 2023–2026 prices the five rebalance rules end 4.56% apart. Hedging per name from the reference instead of Black on the index changes the daily hedge P&L on 1e8 CNY by σ 14,322 CNY/day with fixed shares and by σ 325 CNY/day with daily rebalancing. The rule, not the model, decides how much a per-name model is worth.

01
SUMMARY

Desk read

Same real prices, five index rules, two models. The single-underlying desk model (Black on the index, ΔI split by current shares) is compared with a per-name Monte Carlo reference, first as a static gap on 35 monthly dates (Stage A), then as daily hedge P&L along the real path (Stage B). All figures in CNY on 1e8 CNY of index notional.

ruleA · ATM PV test/ref − 1A · TECH gap, CNY/1%A · gap σ, CNY/dayB · ref − test σB · att − test σB · ref − att σB · premium gap, CNY

A = Stage A, means over the 35 evaluation dates, 1Y ATM call on 1e8 CNY. B = Stage B, paired daily hedge P&L σ in CNY/day, noise-corrected, pooled over 22 starts. Premium gap = test PV − reference PV at the start, mean over starts.

What the desk should take from it

  • The rebalance rule decides the split error. The per-name split part of the daily hedge gap (reference − attribution) is 14,772 CNY/day on fixed shares (none) and 68 CNY/day under daily rebalancing. In Stage A the mean |split part| per name falls from 4,147 to 13 CNY/1%.
  • Where the split dominates, the desk needs a per-name model. The split part dominates the total-delta part (90% CIs apart) under none; the total-delta (index-vol) part dominates under weekly, daily. That part does not need a per-name model, only a better ΔI. Under quarterly, monthly the two parts are comparable (their 90% CIs overlap).
  • The first-order closed form predicts the split on real calibrations. On the rebalanced rules the fitted slope of the measured split part on the formula is 0.988–0.996 (1 = exact), with an rms residual of 1.2–10.4 CNY/1%.
  • PV. Black on the index prices the ATM call +3.61% off the reference on average under none (range −2.18% to +10.40%) and +0.09% under daily (range −0.09% to +0.25%).

Total return and realized σ over 2023-01-03 → 2026-11-17 (937 sessions). σ convention: demeaned daily log returns, ddof=1, x sqrt(244).

Data
akshare 1.20.65, fetched 2026-11-18; stocks via stock_zh_a_hist_em, ETFs via fund_etf_hist_em, adjust = hfq (total return). Sessions 2023-01-03 → 2026-11-17 on the exchange calendar (listed to 2026-12-31); a suspended name carries its previous close. Raw prices stay in a cache outside the repo.
Index
Base 1,000 on 2023-01-03 at target weights. Between rebalances I(t)=∑iniSi(t); at a rebalance close ni=wiI(t)/Si(t). Rules: none (fixed shares), quarterly, monthly, weekly (first session of each period) and daily.
Derived data
The results JSON holds daily index levels and current weights per rule, not prices. Rule none's levels and weights together rebuild each name's rebased series; that is allowed for this public test case.
Calibration
Both models on the same trailing 244 daily log returns ending on the date: σ2=244·Var(lnS(t+1)/S(t)), demeaned, ddof 1. Reference: per-name vols + sample correlation (PSD-checked). Test: the index's own returns under the same rule.
Clock
1Y = 244 sessions; times are session counts / 244. Rate r = 1.8% for discounting and hedge financing, both models.
Options
European calls on 1e8 CNY of index notional, 1Y. Stage A: struck at 0.9, 1.0, 1.1 × the index on the 10th session of each month from 2024-01-15 (35 dates). Stage B: the ATM call sold on each of 22 starts whose option has expired, strike and units fixed at the start.
MC
Stage A 8,192 × 32 RQMC batches; Stage B 4,096 × 16. Per-name deltas by CRN central bump; pathwise deltas kept for the exact decomposition.

SPLIT

Total delta vs split

The per-name gap against the pathwise reference splits exactly into a total-delta part (the two models disagree on ΔI) and a split part (same ΔI, different allocation across names). The split parts sum to zero over the names.

totali=wiI(ΔItest−ΔIref)u·1%spliti=(wiIΔIref−SiΔipw)u·1%

The split against the first-order closed form

06
STAGE B

Hedging along the real path

On each of 22 starts the desk sells the 1Y ATM call (strike and units fixed at the start), re-marks both models on the trailing window at every close and trades to three hedges over 244 sessions. Every arm is marked to the reference PV, in excess of financing, so the paired difference of two arms is exactly their hedge difference.

PA(t)=∑ihiA(t)(Si(t+1)−gSi(t))−(V(t+1)−gV(t)),g=er/244PA(t)−PB(t)=∑i(hiA(t)−hiB(t))(Si(t+1)−gSi(t))

Day 0 (the premium at the arm's own PV vs the reference PV) is outside the daily series and reported as the premium gap. No trading costs or lots; fractional shares.

07
BUSINESS

Business read

The cost of running the CSI book on the single-underlying model is the extra hedge P&L noise of its deltas against the reference. On 1e8 CNY that is 14,322 CNY/day with fixed shares and 325 CNY/day with daily rebalancing; by point estimate, from smallest to largest: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, none.

ruleref − test σ, CNY/day÷ ref arm σ× √244, CNY÷ premiummean premiumpremium gapsplit σtotal-Δ σ
none14,32223.5%224k3.24%6.9m+266,14414,7726,656
quarterly2,5814.1%40k0.58%6.9m−25,0532,3131,896
monthly1,1261.8%18k0.25%6.9m+14,384790819
weekly8121.3%13k0.18%6.9m+21,668233738
daily3250.5%5.1k0.07%6.9m+10,72468317

√244 scaling assumes independent days: an order of magnitude for a year's accumulated hedge difference, not a measurement. Premium: mean reference PV of the ATM call at the starts. Split σ = reference − attribution; total-Δ σ = attribution − test.

  • Where the single-underlying model is enough. Under weekly, daily the per-name split adds less than the total-delta part: the index-level order is the right structure, and the remaining gap is the index vol and ΔI, which a better vol estimate addresses without a per-name model.
  • What the reference buys for the rest. Under none the split dominates. A per-name model (or at least per-name deltas from it) removes split noise of 14,772 CNY/day under none. The quote is affected too: the premium gap averages +266,144 CNY under none.
  • In between. Under quarterly, monthly the split and total-delta parts are comparable (90% CIs overlap): both a per-name split and a better index vol would help.
  • No pass/fail line. The figures sit next to the premium; what is good enough is the desk's call.

The mechanism (why the split error lives only until the next rebalance and is linear in the stub) is derived and checked on a synthetic basket in the sibling study: CSI basket delta · synthetic study report.

08
CAVEATS

Caveats

  • GBM reference. The truth is a per-name GBM with historical vols and correlation. No smile, no jumps, no stochastic vol; both models would move under implied vols.
  • Historical, not implied, vols. Both models use the same trailing 244-session window; a desk quoting off implied vols would see a different level gap.
  • One period. Evaluation 2024-01-15 onward only, one public test basket.
  • Overlapping starts. The 22 Stage B starts are a month apart with 1Y options: terminal P&L has only 2–3 independent outcomes. The daily paired statistic carries the evidence.
  • Calendar fallback. 165 Stage A records need sessions past 2026-12-31; those use weekdays (no holidays), so their stubs and expiries can be off by holidays.
  • MC noise. The reference deltas carry MC noise. Stage B removes its variance from the paired σ (validated by the independent-seed probe); the Stage A gap σ and the session RMS chart are raw.
  • No costs or lots. Fractional shares, no transaction costs, no 100-share lots.
